about.tagline: Markdown notes on your own filesystem. The files belong to you, not to the application.
about.title: About Tura Notes
attachment.created: Image saved at {path}; insert its link in the intended note.
browser.title: Workspace navigation
caps.notAtomic.body: Saving still checks for outside changes and refuses to overwrite them. What it cannot promise is that a crash in the middle of a save leaves the note whole.
caps.notAtomic.title: This folder cannot replace a file in one step.
conflict.body: Autosave is suspended for this note. Your text is safe in a draft; nothing on disk was overwritten.
conflict.compare.coarse: These versions are too large to line up line by line, so the part that differs is shown as one block. Nothing is hidden.
conflict.compare.kept: Whichever you choose, the other version is kept — the app writes it aside before it does anything.
conflict.compare.removed: The file is no longer on disk.
conflict.compare.title: {name} — yours and the file on disk
conflict.title: {name} changed on disk
device.battery: Allow battery use or unknown power status
device.captureSaved: Publish saved edits to synchronized notes (same path, workspace closed)
device.closeFirst: Close the workspace to review identities or apply received files.
device.collision: Path collision: preserve both notes and choose distinct paths.
device.enabled: Enable scheduled transfer while the app is open
device.explain: Transfer runs while the app is open. Editing stays local; received files are applied only when you choose. Close the workspace before pairing or applying files.
device.metered: Allow limited or unknown network conditions
device.mode.upload: Send local folder to empty inbox
device.paired: Paired. The summary above shows the connection state.
device.private: Allow private network addresses for this server
device.probe.address: The server address cannot be used: it must be an https:// address with no path, and a private address also needs the permission below.
device.probe.credentialFile: The credential file was refused before anything was sent: it must be an absolute path to a file only you can read (chmod 600).
device.probe.credentialShape: That file does not contain a credential. Download it again from the server that issued it.
device.probe.mismatch: The credential is for {name}, not for what the field says.
device.probe.refused: The server answered and rejected this credential. It may have been revoked, or belong to another server.
device.probe.review: This credential needs server-side review, which device sync cannot use.
device.probe.unexpected: Something answered and it was not this API — another site on the same name, or an error from the proxy in front of it.
device.probe.unreachable: Nothing answered: the name does not resolve, or the connection or TLS handshake failed.
device.reason.network_limited_or_unknown: Paused: network conditions are limited or unknown.
device.reason.offline: Offline, or waiting for a fresh connection check.
device.reason.power_limited_or_unknown: Paused: battery power or unknown power status.
device.reason.saved_receiver_changes: Saved local changes differ from the received version. Enable saved-edit capture for synchronized notes at the same path, or use explicit conflict resolution.
device.resolved: Resolution staged. Transfer it, then apply the published resolution from history.
device.title: Device sync
dialog.name: Name
draft.found: An unsaved draft of {name} was recovered.
editor.pickANote: Open a note from the sidebar, or create one.
error.already_exists: A file with that name already exists here.
error.internal: Something went wrong inside notes. This is a bug.
error.io.busy: The file is busy. Trying again shortly.
error.io.disk_full: There is no space left on the disk. Your text is safe in a draft.
error.io.name_too_long: That name is too long for this filesystem.
error.io.not_found: The file is gone from the disk.
error.io.other: The write failed. Your text is safe in a draft.
error.io.permission_denied: Permission denied writing that file. Your text is safe in a draft.
error.io.read_only_filesystem: That filesystem is read-only. Your text is safe in a draft.
error.lock_timeout: Another process is writing to this workspace.
error.outside_root: That path is outside the workspace.
error.schema_ahead: This data was written by a newer version. Update Notes.
error.symlink_not_followed: That is a link, and links are not followed.
error.unavailable: The workspace folder is not reachable.
error.unsupported: This storage does not support that.
explorer.title: Explorer
index.failed: Index unavailable. Literal and regex search still work.
index.partial: {count} entries skipped; results may be incomplete
knowledge.invalidYaml: Invalid or oversized YAML front matter. The note remains editable.
knowledge.noteList: Open a note from the graph
knowledge.partial: The index or displayed graph is partial. Rebuild or narrow the filter.
palette.filesPlaceholder: Type part of a note's name
pdf.body: Review the extracted plain text. The PDF is not copied; saving creates a Markdown note.
pdf.title: Import PDF text
preview.blocked: {count} remote image(s) were not loaded. Blocking them keeps this note from telling anyone it was opened.
preview.blocked.allow: Allow remote images in this workspace
preview.failed: The preview could not be rendered. The note itself is untouched.
rail.graphSoon: Graph view arrives at 0.3, with backlinks
rail.label: Sidebar panels
readonly.mixed_eol: This file mixes line endings. It is open read-only, because saving would silently rewrite them.
readonly.not_utf8: This file is not valid UTF-8. It is open read-only; nothing will be converted without your say-so.
readonly.workspace: This workspace's state was written by a newer version of notes, so nothing here will be overwritten.
received.busy: Another operation is finishing. Try again in a moment.
received.dirty: Save your edits and resolve drafts or conflicts before applying.
received.pick: Choose the receive queue created by notes-sync-client
received.ready: Receive queue connected. Transfer with the CLI, then apply here.
received.recovery: Editing is paused until the document can be reloaded safely.
received.reloaded: Document reloaded. Apply again to resume any pending revisions.
received.title: Received revisions
references.dirty: Save or resolve the current note before moving.
references.expired: The workspace changed. Start the move again.
references.explain: Select the files whose links should be updated. Unchecked files are left unchanged. Originals are backed up in app data.
references.failed: Moved, but {count} files changed or could not be written. Review the backup and remaining links.
references.skipped: {count} candidate files have no safe edits. Code, raw HTML and escaped destinations are not rewritten.
references.title: Review links before moving
references.unavailable: The link index is unavailable. Move without updating references? Existing links may need manual repair.
search.badPattern: That is not a valid regular expression.
search.partial: Partial index results. Rebuild or wait for indexing to finish.
search.readsDisk: Searches what is saved on disk.
search.title: Search the workspace
search.unsavedWarning: This note has unsaved changes, which have not been searched.
settings.title: Settings
tabs.label: Open notes
toolbar.heading: Heading
toolbar.label: Markdown formatting
tree.actions.hint: {path} — right-click for rename, duplicate, move and delete
tree.create.where: It is created in the workspace root. To create inside a folder, right-click the folder.
tree.delete.permanent: {name} was deleted permanently — this filesystem has no trash.
tree.delete.trashed: {name} was moved to the trash, so it can be put back.
tree.move.prompt: Folder to move it into, relative to the workspace root (empty for the root)
tree.newFolder.prompt: Name — “/” is not allowed; nest by creating inside the folder
tree.newNote.prompt: Name — “.md” is added if you leave it off, and “/” is not allowed here
update.closeWorkspace: Nothing was installed: your workspace is still open.
update.confirm: The app will close your workspace, download the update, install it and restart.
update.error: The update could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.
update.installing: Downloading and installing… Please keep the app open.
update.title: Tura Notes update
update.unsupported: Update this installation through its package manager or download a new installer.
view.hint: Ctrl+E cycles Source, Preview and Split
watch.degraded: Changes made by other programs are picked up every few seconds rather than instantly: {reason}
watch.overLimit: {count} folders are not being watched: this system's watch limit is full, so changes in them appear within a few seconds instead of instantly. Raise it with sysctl fs.inotify.max_user_watches.
watch.unreadable: {count} folders could not be read and were skipped
welcome.subtitle: Your folder. Your Markdown files. Nothing else.
welcome.title: Tura Notes
workspace.dirtyBody: {name} has unsaved changes. Closing this workspace saves it first.
